title: LRU Cache

approaches.name: Hash map plus doubly linked list

examples.body:
```text
put(1, 1)   cache: [1]
put(2, 2)   cache: [2, 1]
get(1) -> 1 cache: [1, 2]
put(3, 3)   evicts 2, cache: [3, 1]
get(2) -> -1
```

constraints: Keys and values are between 0 and 10,000.
Up to 200,000 calls may be made.
Every operation should run in constant time on average.
